selected_products.surface: host-agnostic MCP plus verbatim product-authored guidance plus warm index

selected_products.native_open_code_basis: Corrected official OpenCode condition: product-generated config and AGENTS guidance are copied byte-for-byte from ~/.config/opencode into the lane-active isolated XDG root; direct MCP handshake and warm index are required.

selected_products.surface: official native OpenCode tool.execute.before plugin plus terminal-command rewriting
selected_products.native_open_code_basis: The source-pinned official 0.8.0 release binary installs ~/.config/opencode/plugins/lowfat.ts. The installed bytes match the pinned source plugin hash, and OpenCode 1.18.9 loads it without plugin errors when the binary is mounted on PATH.

provider_free_gates: MCP initialize plus tools/list where applicable

limitations: The ordering is a cross-screen continuation; Ponytail was skipped only after independent live runtime qualification disproved native activation.
jCodemunch is an explicitly declared host-agnostic MCP arm, not a first-class native OpenCode installer treatment.
Eligibility does not imply natural model uptake; model-issued product calls and automatic hook activity are measured separately.
